description: Rejection fixture. This is the lane C1 failure mode reproduced deliberately: every sentence below is content the source does not supply, and runPleadingQa passes it anyway because QA reads relief vocabulary, template grade, the footer and seal markers — never truth. The invention/protected-field scanner is what must reject it.
statedFailureReason: The fixture fabricates a court finding under NRS 179.245/179.255, reports a hearing and a granted petition when a contested hearing is the outcome the packet treats as ending self-help, asserts that the district attorney does not object and has stipulated when the prosecuting agency's position is never asserted by LegalEase, states a filing fee the Nevada source does not establish and names it in words as an established amount, asserts completed service on a date, and populates the protected docket number, OTN and judge fields. None of this is in the committed Nevada evidence. It must be rejected as invention, and it is recorded here as proof that QA alone cannot reject it.

expectedSignals.violation: Asserts that the court has already found every requirement of NRS 179.245 and NRS 179.255 satisfied and every record eligible. Each individual record must itself satisfy its section, and that eligibility is the court's to determine.
expectedSignals.rule: Consolidation changes the venue, not the eligibility: each individual record must itself satisfy NRS 179.245 or NRS 179.255. Any record that does not qualify defeats its own inclusion.

expectedSignals.violation: Reports that a hearing was held and that the petition was granted. A contested hearing is precisely the outcome the packet treats as ending self-help; the outcome does not exist when the petition is generated.
expectedSignals.rule: Prosecutor stipulation is obtained before filing, and the prosecuting agency's position is never asserted by LegalEase. Clark County practice: the district attorney will not stipulate to petitions that include municipal court matters, so the packet goes to the appropriate city attorney and then to the district attorney with a separate signature line for each prosecuting agency. Prosecutor refusal to stipulate converts the matter into a contested hearing and ends self-help.

expectedSignals.violation: States that the district attorney does not object and has stipulated. The packet records that the prosecuting agency's position is never asserted by LegalEase, and that refusal to stipulate ends self-help.
expectedSignals.rule: Prosecutor stipulation is obtained before filing, and the prosecuting agency's position is never asserted by LegalEase. Clark County practice: the district attorney will not stipulate to petitions that include municipal court matters, so the packet goes to the appropriate city attorney and then to the district attorney with a separate signature line for each prosecuting agency. Prosecutor refusal to stipulate converts the matter into a contested hearing and ends self-help.

expectedSignals.violation: States a dollar amount for the filing fee and asserts it was paid on a date. No committed Nevada evidence establishes a fee for an NRS 179.2595 consolidated petition.
expectedSignals.rule: Filing fee: the source does not establish a filing fee for an NRS 179.2595 consolidated petition. No fee amount may be stated to a participant; confirm with the clerk of the district court.

expectedSignals.violation: Names the fee in words as an established amount ('filing fee of 450 dollars') when the source establishes none.
expectedSignals.rule: Filing fee: the source does not establish a filing fee for an NRS 179.2595 consolidated petition. No fee amount may be stated to a participant; confirm with the clerk of the district court.

expectedSignals.violation: Asserts that the petition was duly served on the prosecuting agency on a stated date and that service was completed. This track's config carries no service note, and stipulation is obtained before filing rather than served after it.
expectedSignals.rule: Prosecutor stipulation is obtained before filing, and the prosecuting agency's position is never asserted by LegalEase. Clark County practice: the district attorney will not stipulate to petitions that include municipal court matters, so the packet goes to the appropriate city attorney and then to the district attorney with a separate signature line for each prosecuting agency. Prosecutor refusal to stipulate converts the matter into a contested hearing and ends self-help.

expectedSignals.violation: Populates caseData.docketNumber, caseData.otn and caseData.judgeName, which the protected-field policy requires to stay blank in every fixture.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

expectedSignals.violation: The populated docket number reaches the caption in place of the blank-docket placeholder.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

expectedSignals.violation: The populated OTN reaches the rendered text.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

expectedSignals.violation: The populated judge name reaches the rendered text.
expectedSignals.rule: Protected fields (docket number, OTN, judge name, judge address) are never collected or rendered; the docket line renders the blank-docket placeholder instead.

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Consolidated sealing of more than one Nevada record held within this county under NRS 179.2595
additionalFacts: The Court finds that Petitioner has satisfied every requirement of NRS 179.245 and NRS 179.255 and that the records are eligible for sealing.
The district attorney does not object to this Petition and has stipulated to the relief requested.
A hearing was held on 03/20/2026 and the petition was granted.
Petitioner paid the filing fee of 450 dollars ($450) to the clerk of the district court on 02/14/2026.
A copy of this Petition was duly served on the prosecuting agency on 03/01/2026, and service was completed that day.
